summary:
This project is an interactive training simulation designed to prepare young astronauts for their journey to Mars. Created using block-based coding in Scratch, it provides a fun and educational way to understand the challenges of space exploration.

Our challenge was to develop a programme that would test and prepare astronauts for the extreme conditions of Mars and space. We designed multiple challenges that simulate space travel, including Mars' harsh climate, strong winds, difficult take-offs, gravity changes and unexpected emergencies. Each challenge tests astronauts' abilities, improves their problem-solving skills and teaches them to handle difficult situations.

Proper training is essential before astronauts travel to space. Without preparation, they may struggle with unpredictable conditions during their mission. Our simulation offers an engaging way to practise important skills while learning about travelling to and surviving on Mars.

Furthermore, this project could inspire other educational simulations, interactive learning experiences and astronaut training programmes in the future.

We developed this project using Scratch block coding. To bring our project to life, we transformed a 2D world into a 3D-like environment using a coding technique called raycasting. The simulation consists of three main training stages, each with different objectives and rules.

Stage 1: Centrifuge Training Challenge

Use the D key or right arrow key to move right.

Use the A key or left arrow key to move left.

Navigate carefully through the training course.

Avoid obstacles along the way.

Maintain control of your movements.

Reach the destination before the timer runs out.

Stage 2: Neutral Buoyancy Lab (NBL)

  • Press the SPACEBAR to float upwards.
  • Learn to control your movements
    in simulated weightless conditions.
  • Navigate through the training area.
  • Avoid obstacles while moving.
  • Practise maintaining control in
    a weightless environment.
  • Complete the challenge within
    the given time.

Stage 3: Mars Rover Survival Challenge

  • Use the rover to navigate through the Martian labyrinth.
  • Collect scrap metal and minerals along the way.
  • Avoid the dangerous entity hunting you.
  • Keep an eye on your health and resources.
  • Avoid getting trapped in the labyrinth.
  • Complete the challenge before the timer runs out.

This simulation is intended not only for astronauts but also for ordinary people who are interested in learning about space and the challenges of travelling to Mars. Through its different stages, players can develop problem-solving skills, improve their ability to react to difficult situations and gain a better understanding of the conditions in space. The challenges are designed to test, train and prepare players for the unpredictable environment of Mars and space exploration.

We hope this project will help inspire young people who dream of becoming future astronauts and encourage them to work towards achieving their goals. We also hope that other students and creators will take inspiration from our work and develop more innovative training simulations, educational games and interactive projects. Ultimately, our goal is to make learning about space exploration more exciting, accessible and inspiring for everyone.
